name: Cubbon Park
short_summary: Sprawling colonial-era park in central Bengaluru, perfect for an early-morning walk or a quiet couple stroll under the rain trees.

name: Toit Brewpub
short_summary: Bengaluru's most iconic brewpub — woody interiors, in-house lagers, classic pub food, and a permanent buzz on weekends.

name: Nandi Hills
short_summary: ~60km north of Bengaluru — a popular sunrise drive with mist-soaked viewpoints, an ancient fort, and Tipu's lodge at the top.

name: Coorg (Madikeri)
short_summary: Coffee-plantation country in Karnataka's Western Ghats — homestays among misty hills, Abbey Falls, Raja's Seat sunsets, ~5.5h from BLR.

name: Chikmagalur
short_summary: Birthplace of Indian coffee — rolling estates, Mullayanagiri (Karnataka's tallest peak), and quiet plantation stays. ~4h drive.

name: Sakleshpur
short_summary: Lush Western Ghats town famous for trekking, the Bisle Ghat viewpoint, and railway-bridge walks — ~4h from BLR, peaks during monsoon.

name: Ooty
short_summary: Classic Nilgiris hill station — toy train, Botanical Garden, Ooty Lake. Cooler year-round; ~7-8h drive or overnight bus.

name: Yelagiri
short_summary: Quiet, lesser-crowded hill station ~3.5h east of BLR — Punganur Lake, Swamimalai trek, and laid-back homestays.

name: Mysore Palace
short_summary: Iconic Indo-Saracenic palace — illuminated stunningly on Sundays and during Dasara. Pair with Chamundi Hills for a full day.

name: Skandagiri
short_summary: Pre-dawn trek hill ~70km from BLR — clouds-below-you sunrises if you start by 3am. Permits required; daytime trekking only currently.
